'''Lanni''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as a dockmaster at the [[Greentop Tower]] docking station. After Sinasu became embroiled in a gang war with the rival Hutt [[Noako]], agents of Noako torched Greentop Tower. Lanni was badly burnt in the attack, and she was taken to the [[BactaMax medical center]] for treatment.<ref name="Crates of Krayts" />
